claude.sample_unit: individuals referred for first TTE (temporal validation); also 33,518 UK Biobank participants and 3,628 MIMIC-IV patients

links.outcome: F1 score and false positives for targeted vs untargeted AI-ECG screening across SHD labels
links.effect: Targeted screening in temporal validation (n=5,198) significantly increased F1 (median 0.25 [0.09 to 0.75]) and decreased false positives (median -303 [-715 to -77]) across 26 SHD labels.
links.quote: Compared with untargeted AI-ECG screening, targeted screening in the temporal validation set (n=5,198) was associated with a significant increase in F1 scores (median of 0.25 [range: 0.09 to 0.75]) and decrease in false positives (median of –303 [range: –715 to –77]) across 26 SHD labels.

links.outcome: Targeted screening performance across geographically distinct cohorts (UK Biobank, MIMIC-IV)
links.effect: Similar F1 gains and false-positive reductions: UK Biobank median change -819 (range -3,521 to -459) across 7 labels; MIMIC-IV median -255 (-716 to -86) across 5 labels.
links.quote: Similar increases in F1 scores and reductions in false positives were seen in the UK Biobank (n=33,518; median change in false positives of –819 [range: –3,521 to –459] across 7 SHD labels) and MIMIC-IV (n=3,628; median false positive change of –255 [range: –716 to –86] across 5 SHD labels).
